subject: LumenScale onboarding — PO activation, line‑item remap & temporary spend
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita@lumenscale.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenscale.com
Date: 2026-04-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: LumenScale onboarding - PO request and spend band

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference serving and Procurement asked me to kick off PO issuance. Two quick asks:

1) Can you confirm a provisional PO number so we can complete our internal procurement checklist? Our legal team needs something to reference when signing the SOW.
2) The line items on the quote bundle two SKUs (model-hosting, data-transfer) into a single line. For our ledger we need them split so we can map to separate GL codes.

We expect first‑quarter usage ~ $40k and plan a three‑month ramp to ~ $120k. For now please set a temporary spend cap of $50,000 while we complete vendor verification.

I've attached our completed W‑9 and the vendor onboarding form.

Attachments: Lumenscale_W9.pdf (pdf)

— Anita
Director of Finance, LumenScale
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@lumenscale.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenScale onboarding - PO request and spend band

Anita — thanks for the docs.

Quick confirmation on next steps from our side:
- I can provision a temporary PO reference today to unblock your legal team: PO-20260401-LS-TEMP. That will allow signature and initial invoices against a placeholder.
- Procurement (cc Marissa) needs a clean line‑item split to issue the formal PO in our system. Please confirm the exact four digit GLs you want mapped to the two SKUs, and whether LumenScale prefers separate unit price rows or quantity splits.
- We can set the provisional spend cap to $50,000 as requested; any request to increase this requires finance approval (cc Grace).

Marissa — can your team accept a provisional PO reference while we reconcile the split? If so, please attach the PO assignment file back with the internal PO id so LumenScale can include it on their PO.

Rafael
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Anita Rao <anita@lumenscale.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenscale.com
Date: 2026-04-01T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenScale onboarding - PO request and spend band

Thanks Rafael — confirmed. See answers inline:

> Please confirm the exact four digit GLs you want mapped to the two SKUs

We want:
- Model hosting -> GL 5312 (unit price per model-hour)
- Data transfer -> GL 5421 (banded transfer fees)

We prefer two separate unit price rows so our ledger shows distinct spend categories.

We also attached the signed vendor form and a short mapping doc (LumenLineItemMapping.xlsx). Appreciate the temporary PO — that will let Legal move forward today.

— Anita
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@lumenscale.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: PO allocation & assignment for LumenScale (provisional)

On Thu, Apr 1, 2026 at 10:05 AM Rafael Mendes wrote:
> Rafael — can you provision a temporary PO reference today to unblock your legal team: PO-20260401-LS-TEMP.

Hi all — we've created a provisional assignment record in the procurement tracker to let Legal reference a PO during signature.

Provisional PO id: PO-20260401-LS-TEMP (Status: provisional / awaiting line‑item split)
Action items for LumenScale: please confirm the final unit prices for the two rows and resubmit the mapping file with the exact text you want on invoices. Once we get that, Procurement will:
- Create two invoice lines in the PO system (model-hosting / data-transfer),
- Assign internal PO line ids, and
- Route to Finance for a spend band increase approval if you request > $50k.

I've attached the PO_assignment_20260401.csv with internal line ids prepopulated. Note: our accounting system requires a vendor tax id match; Grace, can you confirm the W‑9 matches Redwood vendor records so we can move to formal issuance?

Attachments: PO_assignment_20260401.csv

Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Rao <anita@lumenscale.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO allocation & assignment for LumenScale (provisional)

Looping back — Legal would like the provisional PO in place so the SOW signature doesn't stall. Finance (cc Grace) — would you be able to approve a one‑time bump to $75k while vendor validation completes? That buys LumenScale runway for the first billing cycle and keeps the deal cadence intact. Deal reference: DEAL-9482.

If Finance is uncomfortable with $75k, can we at least keep the $50k provisional and issue the first invoice immediately against PO-20260401-LS-TEMP? We can reconcile the line‑item split on the next billing run.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Rao <anita@lumenscale.com>

Subject: Re: PO allocation & assignment for LumenScale (provisional)

Thanks team. W‑9 and tax ID match our vendor intake record, so Finance approves provisional PO issuance at the requested $50,000 spend cap immediately.

Request for LumenScale: please invoice against PO-20260401-LS-TEMP and include the two separate line rows (model-hosting / data-transfer) as discussed. If you need an increased spend cap to $75k before the next billing cycle, submit a short justification in this thread with estimated first‑quarter usage; we'll fast‑track review.

I'll mark the PO provisional in the ledger and route the line‑item split to accounting once Marissa confirms final unit prices.

Grace O'Connor
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

- LumenScale to invoice against that provisional PO; include two line rows: Model hosting (GL 5312) and Data transfer (GL 5421).
- Marissa will push the formal PO with internal line ids once final unit prices are received (action: Marissa).

- Related links: HubSpot company page + DocuSign agreement + onboarding drive folder (see links above).
